_about: AHA (Alzheimer's data harmonization), ONG/académica. Caso real 01/10: NSF CogNeuro (PD-24-1699) NO debe quedar (excluye poblaciones clínicas); NSF 26-512 y NIA/NIAGADS sí deben aparecer.
product: Agentic Harmonization Assistant (AHA) and AHA Connect
description: AI-powered multi-modal data harmonization, statistical crosswalks (e.g., MMSE vs MoCA) and researcher matching for Alzheimer's disease and related dementias research in the AD Workbench. Open-science, non-profit infrastructure.
oneLiner: AI harmonization of Alzheimer's datasets and researcher matching
industry: alzheimer's disease research data infrastructure, AI data harmonization
constraints: No equity, no commercial monetization, open-source
useOfFunds: Core software engineering, statistical validation, security hardening and community onboarding over 24 months
